From c9be63d565789b56ca7b0197e2cb78a3671f95a8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Zilin Guan <zilin@seu.edu.cn>
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 09:25:32 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amdgpu: Fix memory leak in amdgpu_acpi_enumerate_xcc()

In amdgpu_acpi_enumerate_xcc(), if amdgpu_acpi_dev_init() returns -ENOMEM,
the function returns directly without releasing the allocated xcc_info,
resulting in a memory leak.

Fix this by ensuring that xcc_info is properly freed in the error paths.

Compile tested only. Issue found using a prototype static analysis tool
and code review.

Fixes: 4d5275ab0b18 ("drm/amdgpu: Add parsing of acpi xcc objects")
Reviewed-by: Lijo Lazar <lijo.lazar@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Zilin Guan <zilin@seu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_acpi.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_acpi.c
index c126d1bf2bc8..02d5abf9df2b 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_acpi.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_acpi.c
@@ -1186,8 +1186,10 @@ int amdgpu_acpi_enumerate_xcc(void)
 		if (!dev_info)
 			ret = amdgpu_acpi_dev_init(&dev_info, xcc_info, sbdf);
 
-		if (ret == -ENOMEM)
+		if (ret == -ENOMEM) {
+			kfree(xcc_info);
 			return ret;
+		}
 
 		if (!dev_info) {
 			kfree(xcc_info);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a memory leak in the `amdgpu_acpi_enumerate_xcc()` function within `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_acpi.c`. 

- **Modification**: In the error handling branch where `ret == -ENOMEM` (returned by `amdgpu_acpi_dev_init()`), the patch adds `kfree(xcc_info);` before the function returns. Previously, the function returned immediately without freeing the previously allocated `xcc_info`, causing a memory leak. 

- **Relationship**: The `xcc_info` structure is allocated earlier in the function. If `amdgpu_acpi_dev_init()` fails with `-ENOMEM`, the function must release this allocation to avoid leaking memory. The patch mirrors the existing cleanup code for another error path (where `dev_info` is NULL) that already frees `xcc_info`. Thus, this fix ensures consistent resource deallocation across all error paths.
